[[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]] were the defending champions. The season began on 22 August 2025 and concluded on 16 May 2026.{{cite web|url=https://www.dfl.de/de/aktuelles/rahmenterminkalender-fur-die-saison-2025-26/|title=Rahmenterminkalender für die Saison 2025/26: Bundesliga-Auftakt am 22. August 2025|website=dfl.de|access-date=8 November 2024 |language=de}}{{Cite web |title=Bayern Munich to host RB Leipzig in 2025/26 Bundesliga season opener |url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/bayern-munich-host-rb-leipzig-2025-26-new-season-opening-fixture-32821 |access-date=2026-08-25 |website=bundesliga.com - the official Bundesliga website |language=en}} On 19 April 2026, Bayern Munich were crowned Bundesliga champions for the 34th time (their 35th overall German title) with four matches to spare following a 4–2 win over [[VfB Stuttgart]].{{cite web|url=https://onefootball.com/en/news/official-bayern-munich-crowned-german-champions-42736664|title=Official: Bayern Munich crowned German champions|website=Onefootball|access-date=19 April 2026|language=English|archive-date=20 April 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260420084400/https://onefootball.com/en/news/official-bayern-munich-crowned-german-champions-42736664|url-status=live}} Bayern also broke their own Bundesliga single-season goals record (101, set in [[1971–72 Bundesliga|1971–72]]) with five matches remaining,{{cite web |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/apr/11/european-football-bayern-munich-barcelona-milan-juventus |title=European football: Bayern break Bundesliga goals record and close on title |work=[[The Guardian]] |date=11 April 2026 |access-date=20 April 2026}} ultimately finishing the campaign with 122 league goals. Among Europe's [[Big Five (association football)|top five leagues]], this season tally ranks as the second-highest in history, behind only [[Torino FC|Torino]]'s 125 goals in [[1947–48 Serie A|1947–48]] (which had six more matches).{{cite web |url=https://www.statmuse.com/fc/ask/most-goals-by-a-team-in-a-season-in-top-5-leagues |title=Most Goals By A Team In A Season In Top 5 Leagues
